symptom: `mxcli test tests/ --list` printed `Found 0 test(s)` and exited 0 over a tree whose only suites sat in a deliberate positive-control folder (`tests/unit/_control`) kept out of the default run, and that read as a green result
cause: The control was out of the default run only because discovery (before #1363) never entered sub-folders; once discovery recursed there was no opt-out, and `--list` treats an empty listing as success (a real run with 0 tests already exits 1 with `no tests found`) while saying nothing about why
insight: **Making discovery recursive needs an opt-out in the same change, and an opt-out must be reported.** Folders starting with `_` below the root are skipped, like dot-folders (the Go toolchain convention); the root named on the command line is always read, so `mxcli test tests/unit/_control` runs the control. `_` folders are collected into `SkippedDirs` and printed on the line after `Found N test(s)` by both the run and `--list`; dot-folders are not (`.git`/`.mxcli` noise). `ListTests` takes a second writer (`hints`, stderr from the command) and writes `emptySuiteError`'s explanation there when it found nothing, so stdout stays what scripts parse; its exit status is still 0, which is the contract of a listing, while a run with no tests exits 1. Do not fix a 'silent 0' by making `--list` fail: CI uses it to ask what exists. Tests: `parser_dir_test.go` (the `_control` cases, the root-is-read control, the hint writer).
